items.headline: Vaccine programs delivered a record thirty billion dollars in economic benefits to lower income countries in 2025
items.summary: A new annual report from the vaccine alliance Gavi found that immunization programs it supports generated more than thirty billion dollars in economic benefits for lower income countries in 2025, the highest yearly total on record. Those countries also put a record three hundred one million dollars of their own money toward vaccine costs that year.
items.why_it_matters: It shows lower income countries getting bigger returns from vaccination while taking on a growing share of the funding themselves, making the progress less dependent on outside aid.
